title: A notice changes a day
overall: Perform a fresh complete documentary passage in a natural, slightly dry conversational voice. Keep the city and NBC attribution clear. Vary energy through capture, explanation, request and human consequence, without a sales cadence or a solemn drawl. Pronounce Sarrah like Sarah and Morrison as MOR-ih-sun; say NBC as three letters. Keep alleged distinct. Let the final evidence limit settle plainly, without implying resolution. Aim for an ordinary passage lasting 32–34 seconds; preserve clear words instead of forcing the clock. The nineteen-word final line should flow naturally in roughly 7–8 seconds. Follow the supplied continuity instruction and speak only the fenced script.
continuity: One newly synthesized uninterrupted performance of all six exact lines. No reuse of the prior prefix, internal splices, pitch changes or speed changes. Fit picture to the measured take.
timing_note: Timing is a planning range, not a stretched-audio requirement. Final line contains 19 words and should receive ordinary delivery lasting 7–8 seconds. Picture timing and the required story/credit floor follow the actual measured recording.

lines.intent: Enter with the passing camera and one concrete action.

lines.intent: Explain the narrow image-analysis step plainly.

lines.intent: Make city attribution and the human-participation limit unmistakable.
lines.energy: 2.1/5: lower and firm; distinguish the second sentence without a dramatic stop.

lines.text: NBC reports the city sent a courtesy notice to thousands of owners.
lines.intent: Move from procedure to the scale of courtesy requests.

lines.text: A courtesy notice asks owners to fix alleged problems.
lines.intent: Give the request practical force while preserving its alleged status.
lines.energy: 2.4/5: grounded and direct, with a clean downward finish.

lines.text: Sarrah Morrison told NBC the notice sent her into extreme heat to clean her yard. Her outcome was unreported.
lines.intent: Introduce the named resident clearly, give reported physical effort weight, then land the unknown outcome.
lines.energy: 3.0/5 on the reported effort, settling to 2.0/5 for the final evidence limit; no rush through the name or attribution.

review_limits.scope: Fresh full-passage direction only; pronunciation, naturalness, duration and caption alignment require the resulting recording.
